## Key Projects
1. **Dynamic Interactive Portfolio v2**
   - *Tech*: Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Docker.
   - *Summary*: Production developer portfolio featuring real-time DB-backed content, glassmorphic UI, custom session proxy, and real-time contact inbox loops.
   - *Repo*: https://github.com/EnamulBokshi/portfolio-v2

2. **Cloud Infrastructure Observability**
   - *Tech*: TypeScript, Node.js, Redis Pub/Sub, PostgreSQL timeseries, Docker.
   - *Summary*: High-throughput telemetry ingestion pipeline processing millions of events per minute with real-time anomaly alerts and glassmorphic dashboards.
   - *Repo*: https://github.com/EnamulBokshi/cloud-metrics

3. **Real-time Collaboration Engine**
   - *Tech*: React, WebSockets, CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types), TypeScript, Next.js.
   - *Summary*: Low-latency multiplayer state synchronization canvas with live cursor presence and optimistic UI reconciliation.
   - *Repo*: https://github.com/EnamulBokshi/collab-canvas

4. **Autonomous AI Agent Pipeline**
   - *Tech*: Next.js, OpenAI / Google Gemini API, Zod, Docker, TypeScript, PostgreSQL.
   - *Summary*: Agentic workflow orchestrator executing multi-step LLM tool calling, structured JSON output validation, and sandboxed code execution.

5. **Zero-Trust Auth & Session Gateway**
   - *Tech*: Next.js Proxy (`proxy.ts`), jose JWT verification, bcryptjs, Redis token cache.
   - *Summary*: Edge-compatible cryptographic authentication proxy enforcing brute-force IP throttling and sub-millisecond session validation.
